coverage.notes: International foreign-citizen first-year admission for the 2027 main intake. The official Tsinghua FAQ names four fully English-taught undergraduate routes. The 2027 English-programme list posts guides for three; the Tsinghua 2027 schedule independently confirms the Tsinghua–CUHK dual Economics programme (second round only). All other undergraduate routes are mainly Chinese-English taught and excluded, along with isolated English modules, master’s courses and exchange routes. Some Tsinghua 2027 webpages were available in full-length official search-index text but direct page opens returned an older 2026 cache or cache misses; those references are honestly tagged snippet_only, with targeted claims requiring editorial reopening. The dual programme has no located 2027-specific guide and its 2027-28 dual-specific tuition is not confirmed. Complete refers to programme titles within this evidenced scope, not complete verification of every admissions rule. Faculties are omitted because the assignment is a bounded English-programme listing, not an English-medium university-wide catalogue.

institution.summary: Beijing research university offering four fully English-taught undergraduate routes for international applicants in 2027.

programmes.name: Zijing College Global Talents in Science and Engineering Program
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Engineering (Interdisciplinary Engineering or an eligible engineering major)
programmes.campus: Tsinghua University, Haidian District, Beijing, China
programmes.about: A four-year, fully English-taught engineering programme combining information technology, mechanical and civil engineering, design science and interdisciplinary problem-solving.
programmes.overview: Students build an engineering foundation across information science and technology, mechanical engineering, civil engineering and design science, with exposure to artificial intelligence, design thinking and the arts. They undertake engineering design, scientific experimentation and collaborative projects, then pursue interdisciplinary engineering or an eligible engineering specialisation. The residential-college model also emphasises communication, teamwork and cross-cultural study. Graduates receive a Tsinghua engineering bachelor’s degree after meeting their programme and thesis requirements.

programmes.name: Zijing College Urban Regeneration and Design Program
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Engineering (Architecture, Urban Planning or Landscape Architecture); optional fifth-year Bachelor of Architecture
programmes.campus: Tsinghua University, Haidian District, Beijing, China
programmes.about: An English-taught urban-design pathway exploring architecture, planning and landscape design through interdisciplinary technology, design methods and urban-regeneration challenges.
programmes.overview: The programme examines how changing technologies, institutions and data reshape urban spaces and how designers and planners can respond. Students develop design and analytical skills through a personalised curriculum connecting architecture and urban studies with information technology, engineering and design science. Attention to artificial intelligence and design thinking supports responses to urban sustainability and liveability. Students may graduate after four years with a relevant engineering bachelor’s degree or follow a fifth year towards a professional Bachelor of Architecture.

programmes.name: Zhishan College Politics, Economics and Sociology for Global Leaders in Smart Society Program
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Economics (Economics) or Bachelor of Laws (Political Science and Public Administration, International Politics or Sociology)
programmes.campus: Tsinghua University, Haidian District, Beijing, China
programmes.about: A four-year English-taught social-sciences degree integrating politics, economics, sociology, international relations and data-focused study of contemporary society.
programmes.overview: Students study political institutions, economic theory, sociology and international relations alongside statistics, computer programming and artificial intelligence. Published courses include macroeconomics, microeconomics, Chinese political economy and the international system. Applied components such as Global Deep Dive and Leadership Fieldwork for Smart Society involve fieldwork and practical problem-solving. Depending on the selected major and completed degree requirements, graduates receive either a Bachelor of Economics or a Bachelor of Laws from Tsinghua University.

programmes.name: Tsinghua University–The Chinese University of Hong Kong Dual Undergraduate Degree Programme in Economics
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Economics (Tsinghua University) and Bachelor of Social Science in Economics (The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
programmes.campus: Tsinghua University, Beijing, China and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Sha Tin, Hong Kong
programmes.language: English (programme designated fully English by Tsinghua; CUHK specifies major courses in English)
programmes.about: A four-year joint undergraduate economics route awarding degrees from both Tsinghua and CUHK, with approximately two years of study at each university.
programmes.overview: Students combine economics education at CUHK with Tsinghua’s focus on the Chinese economy and financial markets. Study covers economic ideas and international economic issues, and a period of internship training is expected while at Tsinghua. Suggested study patterns divide four years across the Beijing and Hong Kong campuses, with about two years at each institution. Successful students earn a Tsinghua Bachelor of Economics and a CUHK Bachelor of Social Science in Economics; CUHK describes the major courses as English-taught.
